metadata.build_recipe:
mkdir -p build
cc -Iinclude -std=c99 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -MMD -MP -c src/main.c -o build/main.o
cc -Iinclude -std=c99 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -MMD -MP -c src/scm_estimator.c -o build/scm_estimator.o
cc -Iinclude -std=c99 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -MMD -MP -c src/scm_model.c -o build/scm_model.o
cc -Iinclude -std=c99 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -MMD -MP -c src/scm_features.c -o build/scm_features.o
cc -std=c99 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic  build/main.o build/scm_estimator.o build/scm_model.o build/scm_features.o -lm -o build/scm_estimator
metadata.timing_scope: C CPU time is per fit; process wall includes startup/CSV/fit/output and may reflect concurrent-case or other host contention. No MCU latency or energy claim.
metadata.memory_scope: C-reported requested allocations; not process RSS, allocator overhead or stack high-water measurement.
metadata.truth_policy: Physical truth is supplied only to Python scoring after C fitting; never to C initial guesses, priors, objectives or state corrections.
metadata.streaming_scope: Chronological checkpoints with growing-history replay. Previous theta is initialization only; there is no extra previous-posterior factor and no double-counted observations.
metadata.assessment_scope: Undamped local likelihood diagnostics, not a posterior or nonlinear confidence-coverage certificate. Poor numerical statuses remain in the record.

control.semantics: Same final300seconds of observations, reindexed into a separate inference window with unknown entering states. No earlier observations or previous estimate supplied.
control.truth_policy: weak_tail_truth_start is used only for scoring the separate window.

result.joint_normal_semantics: Scaled likelihood Jacobian Gram matrix before damping and Schur reduction; not a posterior
result.joint_normal_coordinates: Scaled theta followed by scaled alpha; packed row-major

scores.trajectory_metric_scope: Retrospective reconstruction within this prefix; endpoint current-SOC metric is separate
scores.identification_note: Absence is a structural statement; presence of excitation does not by itself establish finite-noise identification

assessment.method: Undamped joint likelihood linearization; null directions retain support, positive eigendirections give provisional local ranges.
caveats: No prior precision is inserted into the likelihood matrix.
Noise scaling is inherited from the C matrix; residual RMSE does not renormalize it.
Two-sigma local ranges are not nonlinear confidence or coverage certificates.
This is a reporting diagnostic, not natural-gradient estimation or an optimizer metric.
Carried learning tags must come from the runner's retained history; this function never fabricates age or interval shrinkage.
